headline: Storm Centers on Weathered Expanse as Linn of Mercy Stills
war_summary: The storm has moved since our last edition. The Linn of Mercy, front page but hours ago, has gone quiet and stands wholly Colonial, its eleven posts taken at a Warden toll near six thousand for the day. The Weathered Expanse now bears the heaviest ledger — eleven thousand Colonial and twelve thousand Warden casualties in twenty-four hours — with base actions logged minutes before this edition around Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, the split narrowed to five Warden posts against four. Stonecradle shows the sharpest casualty rates of the hour, climbing on both sides, after eighteen actions around Buckler Sound and The Reach; the Wardens hold a third post again, though six remain Colonial, and the ground has rested some hours. Stlican Shelf logged seven actions, Thornhold busiest, standing five Warden posts to four. Farranac Coast reports a steep renewed toll without base action in ten hours, still nine Colonial to two. On Mooring County the Colonials took The Wind Hills, though eleven of twelve posts remain Warden. The Gutter and Fisherman's Row, busy yesterday, are silent, while Callahan's Passage grinds on with mounting losses. No victor is declared; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
